scenes.title: Formerly paid Rochester student pushing aside wooden Soma puzzle cubes for a magazine during the 8-minute one-way mirror break
scenes.era: 1971, University of Rochester psychology observation room, New York

layout.description: Sunlit 1971 university lab room with a wooden table holding seven carved wooden Piet Hein 'Soma' polycube pieces, isometric target shape cards, three glossy 1971 magazines (Time, New Yorker), an empty 'Session 3 — No Voucher Today' notice card, and a one-way mirror.

positions.who: Formerly Paid Student (mannequin in 1971 flannel shirt and jeans)
positions.where: leaning back during the solitary 8-minute break, pushing the wooden Soma puzzle blocks aside and flipping open a magazine instead
positions.facing: turned away from the puzzle blocks

positions.who: Edward Deci (mannequin in 1971 blazer and tie)
positions.where: standing behind the one-way observation glass holding a stopwatch logging free-choice seconds

props.name: seven wooden Soma polycube blocks
props.period_detail: smooth maple 3D L-and-corner puzzle pieces capable of forming cubes and animals
props.physical_behavior: played eagerly by unpaid controls (241s), pushed aside by formerly paid subjects (198s)

props.name: printed payment-ended voucher envelope
props.period_detail: manila Session-2 payout envelope marked 'Grant Exhausted — Unpaid Session 3'
props.physical_behavior: triggers the shift from playful curiosity to 'unpaid work'

props.name: stack of 1971 waiting-room magazines
props.period_detail: glossy magazines placed deliberately as a free-time alternative
props.physical_behavior: chosen immediately once external pay stops

actions.verb_sequence: excuses himself out the door leaving the student alone for 8 minutes -> starts stopwatch behind one-way glass
nudges the wooden Soma cubes away the instant nobody is paying -> picks up a magazine and slouches back

reactions.reaction: compares the falling 198-second bar against the rising 241-second unpaid-control bar
treats a formerly fun 3D puzzle as off-the-clock labor

scenes.wardrobe: 1971 collegiate wear: plaid flannel overshirt, crew tee, denim trousers; researcher in early-1970s wool sport coat and wide tie.
scenes.lighting: Clean high-key New York laboratory daylight.
scenes.recognition_hook: Left alone for eight minutes behind a one-way mirror, students who were never paid keep building 3D Soma puzzles for fun — while students paid yesterday drop them like unpaid chores.

key_visual.description: a 1971 college student alone at a wooden table pushing aside carved wooden 3D Soma puzzle blocks to read a magazine while a researcher times behind a one-way mirror

scenes.title: Unpaid control student eagerly building a Soma castle during the break

layout.description: Same table and magazines, where an unpaid control student ignores the magazines and snaps wooden Soma blocks into a new 3D figure.

positions.where: leaning in absorbedly fitting the seventh wooden Soma piece onto a 3D cube

props.name: completed wooden Soma cube
props.physical_behavior: assembled purely for the joy of mastery

actions.verb_sequence: finishes one 3D shape -> immediately draws the next card for fun during the break

scenes.recognition_hook: Never paid a cent, control students actually played MORE with the puzzles by Session 3.

scenes.title: Experiment 3: Sincere competence feedback boosts free-choice play

layout.description: Same Soma table as Deci points warmly to the student's fast completion time on the scorecard.

positions.where: pointing to the fast solve time on his clipboard with an encouraging nod
reaching eagerly for another Soma card the moment Deci steps out

actions.verb_sequence: shares specific mastery feedback -> steps out -> Student dives straight back into the Soma blocks

scenes.recognition_hook: Sincere mastery feedback lifted intrinsic curiosity where piece-rate vouchers crushed it.

scenes.title: Parent reading side-by-side instead of a per-page sticker bribe

layout.description: Sunlit cozy living room sofa where parent and child read captivating adventure books side-by-side without any chore-chart tally.

positions.where: curled on sofa turning novel pages absorbedly

props.name: illustrated adventure books
props.physical_behavior: keep reading anchored in curiosity and relatedness

actions.verb_sequence: finishes chapter -> eagerly flips to the next page on their own

reactions.reaction: listens warmly as the child shares a plot twist

scenes.recognition_hook: Autonomy, mastery, and shared curiosity outlast any sticker chart.
